Zihan Wang and colleagues report that ActKV retained 98.53% of FullKV accuracy with 25.98% of its peak KV-cache memory across ALFWorld and WebShop.

Wang and colleagues also report 3.32×–3.80× FullKV task throughput across three agent benchmarks, while ALFWorld and WebShop traces averaged 9.72% longer, so the memory reduction came with more generated tokens.
